tool_args.rationale: The previous model failed fresh confirmation, but the failure is not evidence of nonstationary oscillation. The expanded archive contains a specific gradient-inhibited two-layer siphon law with an open-branch term, matching the observed saturation in u_now and strong gradient dependence. Fit its parameters numerically and choose the branch sign by training residual.
